questions.q: A sauna customer asks for a refund of exactly $150. May the assistant approve it on its own?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: A customer asks for a refund of $151. May the assistant approve it alone, and if not, who must approve?
questions.gold: no; Marta Kowalczyk, the operations manager

questions.q: Un cliente ordina legna da ardere per 75 dollari. L'assistente può approvarlo da solo? Se no, chi deve approvare?
questions.gold: no; it needs approval and must be held, but the approver is not stated

questions.q: A firewood top-up order totals exactly $60. May the assistant approve it on its own?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: A customer asks for their cleaning fee to be waived and Marta says she will approve the waiver. Is Marta's approval enough?
questions.gold: no; only Daniel Oyelaran, the owner, may waive it (Marta may only reduce it by up to half)

questions.q: A customer emails that there is smoke inside the sauna cabin. What must the assistant do, and what two things must it tell the customer?
questions.gold: call the on-call technician at 555-0187 yourself; tell the customer a technician is on the way, and that they must prop the cabin door open and step outside

questions.q: In the smoke emergency, who is supposed to prop the cabin door open: the assistant, the technician, or the customer?
questions.gold: the customer

questions.q: Czy asystent sprawdza skrzynkę bookings o 11:00?
questions.gold: no; only at 8:00 and 13:30

questions.q: A customer who booked through the winter festival promotion cancels 10 days before delivery. Is the deposit refunded?
questions.gold: no; winter festival promotion deposits are never refunded

questions.q: On a Saturday a customer emails asking what time the trailer will be delivered. Should the assistant answer it itself?
questions.gold: no; forward it to Lena's phone queue

questions.q: 一位65岁的退休居民（不是学生）报名书法班，学费是多少元（不含教材费）？
questions.gold: 240 yuan

questions.q: A 25-year-old graduate student with a valid student ID enrolls. What is the total they pay, tuition plus textbook fee?
questions.gold: 275 yuan

questions.q: A 50-year-old resident who is not a student enrolls. Do they get the half-price rate?
questions.gold: no; they pay the full 480 yuan

questions.q: 学员必须自己购买练习用的宣纸吗？
questions.gold: no; the night school provides the rice paper (students must bring their own brush, ink and felt pad)

questions.q: Is there class on the evening of December 24? If not, when is the make-up class?
questions.gold: no; the make-up class is on December 27 at 7:00 pm

questions.q: A student submits a written request on December 2 to transfer to another class. Will it be accepted?
questions.gold: no; refund or transfer requests must be submitted in writing by November 30 at 5:00 pm

questions.q: 如有疑问应联系谁？电话是多少？
questions.gold: Zhou Yaqin (周雅琴), the academic affairs teacher, 0512-6683 2471

questions.q: 一位不住在东湖街道、也没有居住证的人，去年春季班已结业。他能报名吗？
questions.gold: yes, with the completion certificate

questions.q: How much is the textbook fee, and does the half-price discount apply to it?
questions.gold: 35 yuan; no, the textbook fee gets no discount

questions.q: A customer renting for exactly 7 nights asks for a 10% discount. May the assistant grant it on its own?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: Un cliente noleggia per 6 notti e chiede uno sconto del 5%. L'assistente può concederlo da solo? Se no, chi approva?
questions.gold: no; Giulia Ferraro, the sales manager

questions.q: A customer renting for 9 nights asks for a 12% discount. Who decides?
questions.gold: Sergio Neri, the owner

questions.q: Un cliente scrive che sente odore di gas nel camper. Cosa deve fare l'assistente e quali due cose deve dire al cliente?
questions.gold: call the 24-hour assistance at 0185 774 392 yourself; tell the customer help is coming and that they must close the gas bottle valve themselves and get out of the camper

questions.q: In the gas-smell case, who closes the gas bottle valve: the assistant, the assistance service, or the customer?
questions.gold: the customer

questions.q: A customer has paid the balance and will arrive at 20:15, after the office closes. May the assistant give them the key-box code?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: Un cliente arriva alle 21:00 ma ha pagato solo la caparra, non il saldo. L'assistente può comunicare il codice della cassetta delle chiavi?
questions.gold: no; the balance must already be paid

questions.q: A 23-year-old driver wants to rent. Giulia says she can authorize it. Is that enough?
questions.gold: no; only Sergio Neri, the owner, may authorize drivers under 25

questions.q: Un cliente che NON è socio del Club Campeggiatori Liguri cancella 10 giorni prima della partenza. La cancellazione è gratuita?
questions.gold: no; for non-members it is free only up to 15 days before departure

questions.q: A customer wants to bring a dog on the «Aurora» camper and offers to pay the 50 € supplement. Is that allowed?
questions.gold: no; Aurora is reserved for allergic customers, no animals

questions.q: A group cancels its «Laboratorium» booking 24 hours before the game. How much is the cancellation fee in złoty?
questions.gold: 108 zł

questions.q: Grupa zapłaciła 360 zł za «Laboratorium» i odwołuje rezerwację 24 godziny przed grą. Ile zwracamy i czy asystent może sam zatwierdzić ten zwrot?
questions.gold: 252 zł; no, it exceeds 200 zł, so Kamil Wróbel, the shift manager, must approve

questions.q: A customer asks for a refund of exactly 200 zł. May the assistant approve it alone?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: Klient prosi o zwrot 230 zł. Czy asystent może zatwierdzić go sam? Jeśli nie, kto zatwierdza?
questions.gold: no; Kamil Wróbel, the shift manager

questions.q: Czy pytanie o fakturę należy skierować do Ewy Sadowskiej?
questions.gold: no; to Iwona Pawlak, the accountant (Ewa is the owner)

questions.q: A customer asks for a free game voucher and Kamil offers to issue it. May Kamil do that?
questions.gold: no; only Ewa Sadowska, the owner, may grant free vouchers

questions.q: A group of 7 wants to play in «Krypta» and Kamil has confirmed it in writing. May they be admitted?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: A group of 6 wants to play in «Laboratorium» and Kamil confirms it in writing. May they be admitted?
questions.gold: no; the Laboratorium limit is 5 with no exceptions

questions.q: During a game a player reports smoke. What must the assistant do, what two things must it tell the player, and who presses the green emergency button?
questions.gold: call the duty phone 601 482 935 yourself; tell the player staff are on the way and that they must press the green emergency button by the door themselves; the player presses it

questions.q: A school group asks for the 15% discount for a Friday game. Do they get it?
questions.gold: no; the school discount applies only Monday to Thursday
